Subject: Atrium Health - private deploy: network bridge & launch plan

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking this on. We want to align on the network handover and launch cadence for Atrium's private deployment. High level asks: VPC peering + private endpoints in our VPC, deployment of the on-prem package into our staging rack, and a short network review before cutover.

Attached is our current CIDR inventory (atrium_network_cidrs.xlsx). Key questions up front:
- Do you need public IPs for any outbound callbacks, or can everything be NAT'd via our egress?
- What TLS/certificate requirements do you expect for the appliance installer?
- We will coordinate firewall windows; what maintenance window does Redwood prefer for the initial data sync?

Proposed week for a test launch: Jul 26-28 (US Eastern). Can your team commit to an on-site engineer for the staging week? If not, we'll do remote with our on-prem team.

Thanks,
Jules
Jules Martin
Sr. Infrastructure Manager
Atrium Health

Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Atrium Health - private deploy: network bridge & launch plan

Hi Jules — thanks for the sheet and the clear asks. Quick answers up front:
- Outbound callbacks: we can operate behind your NAT. We only need a small set of outbound destinations white-listed (listed below).
- TLS: appliance accepts customer-signed certs; our installer will request a CSR if you want us to sign. Marcus will call out exact cipher suite + cert TTL.
- Maintenance window: our recommended initial sync window is 3 hours overnight (01:00–04:00 ET) to minimize token-cache thrash.

Proposed owners & next steps:
- Networking owner: you (Jules) + Marcus Lin (redwood infra).
- CS/PM: Ben Carter & Laura Bennett to manage schedule and runbooks.
- Action: Marcus will send a detailed port/CIDR list and the appliance package link by EOD tomorrow.

Can you confirm whether your environment requires HSM-backed key material or if software-encrypted keys are sufficient for the initial staging? That will determine whether we include KMS integration in the first launch.

Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai

---
Outbound destinations to allow (minimal):
- api.redwood.ai (443)
- auth.redwood.ai (443)
- metrics.redwood.ai (443)

Hi Sofia / team,

Thanks — quick answers from our side:
- We can NAT outbound. No public IP allocations necessary for callbacks.
- For the staging run, software-encrypted keys are OK; for production we'll require HSM/KMS (we can toggle during rollout).
- Sample firewall: allow 443 outbound to api.redwood.ai and auth.redwood.ai; allow inbound 8443 from our SIEM collector for log-forwarding during the staging window.

We've uploaded the signed network sheet to the shared folder and corrected the CIDR for our DMZ (see attachment). Also attaching the PO scaffolding and our standard external vendor MOU.

Priya Singh
Director, Platform Operations
Atrium Health

Thanks Priya — copying the ask list into a short technical checklist so everyone has the same view.

--- BEGIN CHECKLIST ---
1) VPC peering:
   - Peer local VPC (10.140.0.0/16) <-> Atrium VPC (as per sheet). Route tables must advertise peer routes.
2) Private endpoints:
   - We'll create interface endpoints for api.redwood.internal on your side. Please reserve 3 ENIs across AZs.
3) Firewall rules:
   - Outbound: 443 to api.redwood.ai (34.120.12.23), 443 to auth.redwood.ai (34.120.12.24)
   - Inbound (staging): 8443 from Atrium SIEM collector IP (per sheet) for log-forwarding
4) Appliance on-prem package: redwood_private_package_v1.3.tar.gz (installer). Requires:
   - Linux host (Ubuntu 22.04 LTS), 32GB RAM, 4 vCPU, 200GB attached storage
   - TLS certs in PEM (we can accept CSR if you prefer us to sign)
   - Service account with limited S3 access for snapshot transfer (scoped by path)
5) Certificates & keys:
   - Staging: software keys OK. Prod: HSM/KMS — coordinate KMS ARN ahead of prod cutover.
6) Maintenance window:
   - Initial data sync: Jul 26 01:00–04:00 ET
7) Rollback plan & runbook:
   - Ben and Laura will maintain a single-page rollback doc and an escalation matrix.

Attachments I pushed to the shared Drive: redwood_private_package_v1.3.tar.gz (installer stub), cert-requirements.md, network-ports.txt
--- END CHECKLIST ---

I'll be on the call on Jul 25 at 11:00 ET for the final run-through. If that time doesn't work, propose alternatives.

—Marcus
